title: Software Engineer I
summary: Builds and ships well-scoped product features with guidance from senior engineers, learning the codebase, tooling and team practices.
responsibilities: Implement well-defined features and bug fixes with clear acceptance criteria
Write unit and integration tests for the code you ship
Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback
Pair with senior engineers to learn system design and debugging practices
Document changes so teammates can support what you build
qualifications: 0-2 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent projects
Working knowledge of at least one modern programming language
Familiarity with version control and basic testing practices
Eagerness to learn and respond to feedback

title: Software Engineer II
summary: Owns delivery of medium-complexity features end to end, partnering with product and design to build reliable customer-facing functionality.
responsibilities: Own delivery of medium-complexity features from design to production
Write maintainable, well-tested code and review teammates' pull requests
Debug and resolve production issues, including on-call rotations
Contribute to technical design discussions and estimate work accurately
Improve developer tooling, CI pipelines and documentation
qualifications: 2-5 years of professional software engineering experience
Strong proficiency in a typed language such as TypeScript, Java or Go
Experience building and consuming REST APIs
Experience working with relational or document databases

title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Leads the design and delivery of significant systems, raises the engineering bar for the team and mentors other engineers.
responsibilities: Lead technical design for large features and services, from proposal through rollout
Set code quality, testing and observability standards for the team
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through reviews, pairing and design feedback
Partner with product managers to shape scope and sequence delivery
Identify and pay down technical debt that slows the team
Drive incident response and post-incident improvements
qualifications: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Track record of designing and operating production systems at scale
Deep expertise in at least one backend or frontend stack
Experience mentoring engineers and leading projects across teams

title: Staff Software Engineer
summary: Sets technical direction across multiple teams, solving ambiguous, high-impact problems and multiplying the effectiveness of other engineers.
responsibilities: Define multi-quarter technical strategy for a product area or platform
Lead architecture for cross-team initiatives and resolve competing technical approaches
Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders
Establish engineering standards and reusable platform capabilities
Partner with engineering and product leadership on prioritization
qualifications: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including senior-level technical leadership
Experience leading architecture across multiple teams or services
Excellent written communication for design documents and decision records

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
summary: Builds fast, accessible user interfaces and leads frontend architecture for the product.
responsibilities: Architect and build complex React applications with a focus on performance and accessibility
Own the shared component library and design-system integration with designers
Define frontend testing, linting and release practices
Mentor engineers on frontend patterns and code quality
Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals and error rates
qualifications: 5+ years building production web applications
Expert knowledge of React and TypeScript
Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG) and performance optimization

title: DevOps Engineer
summary: Builds and operates the infrastructure, deployment pipelines and observability that let engineering ship safely.
responsibilities: Maintain infrastructure as code for cloud environments
Build and improve CI/CD pipelines to shorten lead time for changes
Operate container orchestration and service networking
Set up monitoring, alerting and on-call runbooks
Partner with security on access controls and vulnerability remediation
qualifications: 2-5 years of DevOps, SRE or infrastructure experience
Hands-on experience with a major cloud provider
Experience with containers and infrastructure as code

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Designs, ships and evaluates machine-learning and LLM-powered features in production, owning data pipelines through to monitoring.
responsibilities: Design and deploy ML and LLM-based features from prototype to production
Build evaluation datasets and offline metrics that gate releases
Own feature pipelines, model serving and latency/cost budgets
Monitor model quality, drift and failure modes in production
Partner with product to translate user problems into measurable ML objectives
qualifications: 5+ years of experience in machine learning or applied ML engineering
Strong Python and experience with a deep learning framework
Experience running models in production with monitoring
Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation and agent frameworks is a plus

title: Data Analyst
summary: Turns business questions into trustworthy analyses and dashboards that guide product and go-to-market decisions.
responsibilities: Partner with stakeholders to define metrics and answer business questions
Write efficient SQL to build reliable datasets
Build and maintain dashboards for leadership and operating teams
Design and analyze experiments and A/B tests
Communicate findings with clear recommendations
qualifications: 2-4 years of experience in analytics or business intelligence
Advanced SQL and experience with a BI tool
Solid grounding in statistics and experiment analysis

title: Product Designer
summary: Designs intuitive product experiences end to end, from research and flows to polished, accessible interfaces.
responsibilities: Lead design for features from problem framing through launch
Run user research and usability tests to validate decisions
Produce flows, wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity designs
Contribute components and patterns to the design system
Collaborate closely with engineers during implementation
qualifications: 3+ years of product design experience with a portfolio of shipped work
Proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools
Experience conducting user research

title: Senior Product Designer
summary: Shapes the product experience for a whole area, setting design quality and mentoring other designers.
responsibilities: Own the end-to-end experience for a product area
Define design strategy with product and engineering leads
Lead research programs that inform the roadmap
Mentor designers and run design critiques
Evolve the design system and its governance
qualifications: 6+ years of product design experience
Portfolio demonstrating complex, systems-level design work
Experience mentoring designers

title: Senior Product Manager
summary: Owns the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a product area, aligning engineering, design and go-to-market teams.
responsibilities: Define product strategy and a measurable roadmap for your area
Write clear requirements and prioritize the backlog with engineering
Use qualitative research and data to make trade-off decisions
Align stakeholders across sales, marketing and support on launches
Track outcome metrics and iterate after launch
qualifications: 5+ years of product management experience
Track record of shipping products that moved key metrics
Strong analytical and written communication skills

title: Marketing Specialist
summary: Plans and executes multi-channel campaigns that grow awareness and pipeline.
responsibilities: Plan and execute campaigns across email, social and paid channels
Write and edit campaign copy, landing pages and blog content
Track campaign performance and report on pipeline contribution
Coordinate with design and sales on launches and events
Maintain marketing automation workflows and lists
qualifications: 2-4 years of B2B or B2C marketing experience
Experience with a marketing automation platform
Strong writing and analytical skills

title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
summary: Owns acquisition strategy and experiments across paid and organic channels to hit pipeline targets.
responsibilities: Own the acquisition funnel and channel mix to meet pipeline targets
Design and run growth experiments with clear hypotheses
Manage paid search and social budgets and agency partners
Build attribution and funnel reporting with analytics
Mentor marketing specialists
qualifications: 5+ years in growth or performance marketing
Experience managing six-figure paid budgets
Strong analytical and experimentation skills

title: Account Executive
summary: Runs the full sales cycle for mid-market customers, from discovery through close.
responsibilities: Manage a pipeline of mid-market opportunities from discovery to close
Run discovery calls, demos and commercial negotiations
Forecast accurately and keep CRM records up to date
Partner with customer success for smooth handoffs
Share customer feedback with product and marketing
qualifications: 2-4 years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets
Experience with a CRM such as Salesforce

title: Customer Success Manager
summary: Helps customers adopt the product and achieve their goals, driving retention and expansion.
responsibilities: Own onboarding and adoption for a book of customer accounts
Run regular business reviews and success planning
Identify risk early and coordinate save plans
Surface expansion opportunities with the sales team
Advocate for customer needs with product
qualifications: 2-4 years in customer success or account management
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Experience with CRM and support tools

title: Technical Recruiter
summary: Partners with hiring managers to attract and hire great technical talent with a fair, consistent process.
responsibilities: Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and interview plans
Source and engage candidates through multiple channels
Manage candidates through a structured, inclusive interview process
Extend offers and negotiate within approved compensation bands
Report on funnel metrics and improve time to hire
qualifications: 2-4 years of recruiting experience, ideally technical roles
Familiarity with structured interviewing practices
Experience with an applicant tracking system

title: Senior HR Business Partner
summary: Advises leaders on organization design, performance and employee relations to build healthy, high-performing teams.
responsibilities: Partner with business leaders on org design and workforce planning
Coach managers on performance, feedback and career development
Lead employee relations cases with fairness and confidentiality
Run performance and compensation review cycles for your groups
Use people data to identify and address engagement risks
qualifications: 6+ years of HR business partnering experience
Strong knowledge of employment law and practice
Experience coaching senior leaders

title: Financial Analyst
summary: Builds the models, forecasts and reporting that help leaders plan and spend wisely.
responsibilities: Build and maintain financial models for budgeting and forecasting
Prepare monthly variance analysis and management reporting
Partner with department leaders on headcount and spend plans
Support board and investor reporting
Improve finance processes and data quality
qualifications: 2-4 years in FP&A, corporate finance or investment banking
Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills
Strong attention to detail

title: Engineering Manager
summary: Leads a team of engineers to deliver reliably while growing people, process and technical quality.
responsibilities: Hire, onboard and develop a team of 5-8 engineers
Run planning and delivery so commitments are met predictably
Hold regular one-on-ones and give actionable career feedback
Partner with product and design on roadmap and trade-offs
Maintain technical quality, operational health and on-call sustainability
qualifications: 6+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years managing engineers
Track record of hiring and growing engineers
Strong technical judgment to guide architecture discussions

title: Software Engineering Intern
summary: Works on a real project with a mentor, shipping code to production and learning professional engineering practices.
responsibilities: Build a scoped project with guidance from a dedicated mentor
Write and test code that ships to production
Participate in team rituals such as standups and code review
Present your project to the team at the end of the internship
qualifications: Currently pursuing a degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent self-taught experience
Experience with at least one programming language through coursework or projects
